Minister Eker meets Sudan's agriculture minister at a joint economic commission session, discussing rising bilateral trade and an upcoming agricultural cooperation agreement.
ORKÖY pilot project installs solar electricity systems for four forest-village households in Konya, aiming to reduce pressure on forests and support rural livelihoods.
Minister Yumaklı addresses flood and tornado damage to producers in Antalya, noting ongoing TARSİM insurance damage-assessment fieldwork.
Ministry releases 5.1 million carp fry into 727 lakes/ponds nationwide to support small-scale inland fishing and rural incomes.

Agriculture, Health, and Education ministry officials meet to coordinate on school-age children's nutrition and food safety.

Ministry extends deadlines for ear-tagging/registering cattle, sheep and goats and updates livestock transport documentation and penalty rules.
